A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have mapped all chains from the PDB (release 80, March 2002) to the SwissProt protein sequence database.
we have developed a system that can map PDB chains to their EC numbers and provide a Web-based queryable interface to this information.
PDBSprotEC is an automated mapping from PDB chains to the Enzyme Classification system via SwissProt, with the aim of providing a useful resource for the community.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PDBSprotEC database can be updated automatically, using a combination of a Perl script and the SwissProt database.
the mapping between chains and EC numbers can be done automatically and with a reasonable degree of accuracy.
